zh.title: 新功能
items: **计划批准即自动执行**：Plan 模式下点击「批准并执行」后，计划会自动连续推进直到完成，无需再手动逐步驱动；执行全程复用 Goal 模式的完整护栏（续推上下文注入、防偏航 re-anchor、完成验证门）。

zh.title: 优化
items: **Explorer 并行调查提速**：同一轮内的多个 Explorer 子调查改为并发池执行（默认并发 5、上限 8），移除累计上限限制，单个 Explorer 失败不再中断整轮；底部进度显示「本轮已完成/本轮总数」。

en.title: What's New
items: **Approve plan starts auto-run**: In Plan mode, “Approve & run” advances the plan continuously to completion without manual step-by-step driving; execution reuses Goal mode’s full guardrails (continuation context, anti-drift re-anchor, completion verification gate).

en.title: Improvements
items: **Faster parallel Explorer work**: Multiple Explorer sub-investigations in the same turn run in a concurrency pool (default 5, max 8), cumulative caps removed, one Explorer failure no longer aborts the whole turn; bottom progress shows “done this turn / total this turn”.
